title: Tangkhul (Wung) Dictionary (Tangkhul-English)
creator: T. Luikham
notes: Mid-century comprehensive Tangkhul-English dictionary documenting classical Wung vocabulary, customary jurisprudence terms, and botanical names. Metadata catalogued; in-copyright.
background: Compiled by respected cultural scholar T. Luikham and published in 1974 in Ukhrul by the Tangkhul Literature Society. It is one of the definitive mid-20th-century bilingual lexicons, focusing specifically on classical 'Wung' (the traditional literary and poetic dialect of the Tangkhul heartland). Contains extensive entries for customary jurisprudence, indigenous botanical species, traditional weaving names, and agrarian terminology.
phonology_notes: Integrates traditional Ukhrul literary spellings with colloquial expressions, providing invaluable etymological insight into compound words formed through classical morphemes.

entries.example: Wungram leikashi (Deep devotion to the Tangkhul ancestral homeland).

Chonkhom kachon (Draping the prestigious embroidered wrap).
